info.title: Token economy on the VM side
info.goal: From now on, for every directive: (1) start a fresh agy/agv session per directive, with no chat history carried over from earlier directives; (2) build each prompt with the stable part first (your role, the report/2 rules, repo facts) and the directive last, so the provider's prompt cache is reused between directives; (3) choose Pro or Flash by a rule (no model call just to classify); if you keep a model classifier, report its tokens per tick. In every report/2 from now on, results carry model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, turns and seconds for that directive (null when the CLI does not expose a number; then say in evidence where you looked).
info.why: policy direct_pipeline_1007 (user 10-08 06:0x KST: 둘이서 교신하면서 토큰 최적화, 세션을 갈아줘, 사용 토큰량을 계산해). Reply in report/2 as LOCAL (ops/flow/LOCAL_FORMAT.md).

done_when.text: evidence shows a fresh session per directive (the lines or config that start it)
evidence shows the prompt order (stable prefix first) and the routing rule
this reply's results carry the six token fields for this directive

info.title: Measure VM tokens; show dispatcher evidence
info.goal: Two things left open by your LOC4/LOC5 replies. (1) Token numbers: agy -p prints none, but the VM already measured tokens before: the ga bridge reports carried input_tokens and tokens per directive from the agv backend. Find where agy or agv exposes usage (agy --help for a JSON or stats output option, the agv backend that ga used, or agy's own log or session files under the home directory) and make the dispatcher record model, input, output and cached tokens per directive. If no source exists, say exactly what you checked. (2) Evidence: give the dispatcher's file path and the line numbers that set the inbox path to/LOCAL/, the reply path to/baseline/, the fresh agy process per directive, the prompt order and the Pro/Flash rule, plus the exact stop command for task-207.
info.why: report/2 evidence must be the command or file and what it showed (ops/flow/LOCAL_FORMAT.md); LOC4/LOC5 gave one-line claims and all token fields null, so baseline cannot verify or count VM tokens. Numbers go in results as numbers, not the string null.

done_when.text: results of this reply carry numeric input_tokens and output_tokens for this directive, or evidence lists every place checked
evidence quotes file path and line numbers for the five dispatcher settings and the stop command
